name: start_task
description:
Start one asynchronous browser task that can interact with external pages.

Call once for a new task, after checking capabilities and agreeing the scope
with the user. This launches real work; it is not a preview or an approval.
Returns result (including run_id) and pending_proposal, initially often null
with reason preparing_admission. Poll get_task; when awaiting_human_admission
with a pending proposal, use present_admission with its exact identifiers.
If the start response is lost, call get_task without run_id to recover the
single retained run. Never retry start_task automatically: a retry can start
new work after retention expires. busy means a run is still retained.
Tool errors use isError=true and {"error": code}; inspect them before acting.

request.description: Bounded browser task: goal/start URL, input values, independent checks, budgets and privacy policy. No caller-supplied approval or grant fields.

kind.description: Independent check: route/text/value expect a string, visible a boolean, count a nonnegative integer. fixture_state is reserved for trusted adapters and rejected in public requests.
kind.title: Kind

target.description: Empty for route; otherwise a supported CSS selector (up to 512 UTF-8 bytes). XPath and Playwright selector engines are rejected.
target.title: Target

expected.description: Exact expected value for the check kind; string, boolean or integer, never a caller assertion that verification passed.
expected.title: Expected

max_seconds.description: Finite wall-clock task budget in seconds.
max_seconds.title: Max Seconds

max_input_bytes.description: Cumulative provider input budget in bytes.
max_input_bytes.title: Max Input Bytes

max_output_bytes.description: Cumulative provider output budget in bytes.
max_output_bytes.title: Max Output Bytes

max_stored_bytes.description: Maximum retained artifact storage in bytes.
max_stored_bytes.title: Max Stored Bytes

PrivacyPolicy.description: Local filter. Do not send or log blocked_literals.

blocked_literals.description: Local payload denylist: up to 32 nonempty literals of 1..256 characters. Never send or log these values.
blocked_literals.title: Blocked Literals

send_images.description: Whether image payloads may be sent to the provider; does not guarantee privacy or grant admission.
send_images.title: Send Images

PrivacyPolicy.title: PrivacyPolicy

goal.description: User-agreed browser goal; nonempty after trimming. A goal is not approval for consequential actions.
goal.title: Goal

start_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) starting URL, without userinfo, whitespace or control characters.
start_url.title: Start Url

mode.description: isolated creates an owned browser session; existing_chrome uses the supported existing-browser attachment. Check capabilities.modes first.
mode.title: Mode

values.description: Task input values: at most 32 string entries, keys <=128 characters and values <=4000. Use an empty object when no inputs are needed.
values.title: Values

checks.description: Up to 32 independent completion checks. An empty list cannot establish verified functional completion.
checks.title: Checks

viewports.description: One to three CSS-pixel viewport sizes for visual diagnostics.
viewports.title: Viewports

limits.description: Required execution and byte budgets; an empty object uses bounded defaults.

privacy.description: Required local privacy controls; an empty object uses defaults with image sending disabled.

visual.description: Request visual diagnostics at the selected viewports; separate from functional verification.
visual.title: Visual

result.description: Run ID, state, usage, evidence and artifact IDs. A result is not authorization.

pending_proposal.description: Current admission scope, or null while preparing/running/finished. Pass its exact identifiers to present_admission only when awaiting_human_admission.

PendingProposal.description: Copy these identifiers verbatim; the remaining scope fields depend on proposal kind.
PendingProposal.title: PendingProposal

TaskResult.description: Closed outcome. Recording admission does not authorize an effect.
TaskResult.title: TaskResult

outputSchema.description: Current run snapshot; queued/awaiting_human_admission/running need further polling.
outputSchema.title: TaskSnapshot

name: get_task
description:
Read the current snapshot of one retained task without starting work.

Supply run_id to poll that run; omit it (or pass JSON null) to recover the
single retained run after a lost start_task response. Returns result and
pending_proposal. queued, awaiting_human_admission and running are not final;
reason finalizing means cleanup is still in progress. Present a pending
admission only with its exact identifiers; read result.artifact_ids with
read_artifact. A terminal outcome_unknown/cleanup_unknown is not proof of
successful cleanup. unknown/expired errors mean no matching retained run,
not evidence that no browser action occurred. Do not restart automatically.

run_id.description: Exact result.run_id from a task response. Omit or pass JSON null to recover the single retained run after a lost start response; the string 'null' is an ordinary ID.
run_id.title: Run Id

result.description: Run ID, state, usage, evidence and artifact IDs. A result is not authorization.

pending_proposal.description: Current admission scope, or null while preparing/running/finished. Pass its exact identifiers to present_admission only when awaiting_human_admission.

PendingProposal.description: Copy these identifiers verbatim; the remaining scope fields depend on proposal kind.
PendingProposal.title: PendingProposal

TaskResult.description: Closed outcome. Recording admission does not authorize an effect.
TaskResult.title: TaskResult

outputSchema.description: Current run snapshot; queued/awaiting_human_admission/running need further polling.
outputSchema.title: TaskSnapshot

name: cancel_task
description:
Request cancellation of a retained browser run and revoke its admission.

Use when the user wants the run stopped. Returns result and pending_proposal;
cancellation is a request, not an immediate cleanup receipt or rollback of
earlier page changes. Poll get_task until finalization/cleanup finishes.
outcome_unknown with cleanup_unknown requires inspection, not a success claim
or automatic restart. Repeated cancellation of the same retained run adds no
new work; unknown/expired returns isError=true with {"error": code}.

run_id.description: Exact result.run_id of the retained run to stop; obtain it with get_task if the start response was lost.
run_id.title: Run Id

result.description: Run ID, state, usage, evidence and artifact IDs. A result is not authorization.

pending_proposal.description: Current admission scope, or null while preparing/running/finished. Pass its exact identifiers to present_admission only when awaiting_human_admission.

PendingProposal.description: Copy these identifiers verbatim; the remaining scope fields depend on proposal kind.
PendingProposal.title: PendingProposal

TaskResult.description: Closed outcome. Recording admission does not authorize an effect.
TaskResult.title: TaskResult

outputSchema.description: Current run snapshot; queued/awaiting_human_admission/running need further polling.
outputSchema.title: TaskSnapshot

name: read_artifact
description:
Read retained evidence bytes by server-issued run and artifact IDs.

Use result.artifact_ids from get_task, never a local path. Default legacy is
only for a whole artifact fitting one chunk at offset 0; otherwise it returns
artifact_range_required. Choose structured or resource for large artifacts.
Follow next_offset with the same IDs/channel until eof=true; offset and limit
count original bytes, not base64 characters. Explicit channels include total_bytes,
sha256 (whole artifact) and chunk_sha256. structured returns base64 in
structuredContent.content; resource returns it in content's embedded blob.
Errors retain isError=true and {"error": code}, including bad_range for an
offset beyond EOF; unknown/expired runs cannot supply retained artifacts.

run_id.description: Exact result.run_id owning the retained artifact.
run_id.title: Run Id

artifact_id.description: One ID from result.artifact_ids, not a filesystem path or URL.
artifact_id.title: Artifact Id

offset.description: Zero-based byte offset in the original artifact, not a base64 character offset. For pagination, copy next_offset from the prior response.
offset.title: Offset

limit.description: Maximum original bytes per chunk (1..65536), before base64 encoding.
limit.title: Limit

channel.description: legacy: small whole artifact in text and structuredContent; structured: chunk base64 only in structuredContent; resource: chunk base64 in an embedded resource, metadata in structuredContent.
channel.title: Channel

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the entire original artifact, not just this chunk.
sha256.title: Sha256

content.description: Base64 bytes for legacy/structured. Absent for resource: read the embedded resource blob.
content.title: Content

next_offset.description: Next byte offset for explicit channels; null at EOF.
next_offset.title: Next Offset

outputSchema.description: Legacy whole artifact or explicit byte-range metadata; channel selects where base64 appears.
outputSchema.title: ArtifactBody

name: capabilities
description:
Inspect local prerequisites and supported operations before starting a task.

Takes no arguments. Returns browser modes, operations, admission classes/mode,
artifact chunk limits/channels and selected-provider configuration status.
provider_ready and PREREQUISITES_PRESENT describe configuration only: no API,
browser, entitlement or human approval is tested. production_ready remains
false and live/native evidence remains NOT_RUN. A configured provider does
not guarantee successful execution; resolve BLOCKED prerequisites before use.
No credentials are returned and this call does not grant admission.

outputSchema.description: Local prerequisites and supported operations; no live or production certification.
outputSchema.title: CapabilityFacts

name: present_admission
description:
Present a pending action scope through the client's Standard MCP form.

Call only when get_task reports awaiting_human_admission and a non-null
pending_proposal. Copy run_id, proposal_id and digest from that same proposal.
The tool presents a form; calling it does not itself grant permission. Only
the supported form response may record admission, and a host accept is not
proof of a native human click. Never fabricate reviewed/approval/grant fields.
Returns the updated result and pending_proposal; continue with get_task.
Unsupported form clients fail closed. Stale, resolved or concurrent requests
may return isError=true with unknown, presentation_resolved or presentation_busy;
refresh get_task instead of blindly repeating a prompt.

run_id.description: Copy pending_proposal.run_id exactly from the latest task snapshot.
run_id.title: Run Id

proposal_id.description: Copy pending_proposal.proposal_id exactly; do not reuse an old or resolved proposal.
proposal_id.title: Proposal Id

digest.description: Copy pending_proposal.digest verbatim: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters binding the displayed scope. Never calculate or guess it.
digest.title: Digest

PendingProposal.title: PendingProposal

TaskResult.title: TaskResult
